A restless season ahead, a few tips
The subject is shade areas
Shade area notice

Travelers should know that pets waiting for handover must stay in cool, sheltered areas and remain under steady supervision from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. Clear guidance is given before departure, so bring the right carrier, keep documents ready, and follow the direction of staff without delay.

The ground team moves carriers carefully between services and checks each animal with patience. Please keep leashes short, doors secured, and personal items clear of the route. Staff also record service changes in the desk ledger, so any change in carrier, contact details, or travel arrangement should be reported at once. This helps reduce confusion and keeps the process calm for each animal.

If you are traveling with a companion animal, stay near the desk and follow posted directions closely. Bring any special care notes with you and speak to the team before boarding.
